entities.summary: Jacob Waldemar de la Rose is a Swedish professional ice hockey forward currently playing for HC Fribourg-Gottéron of the National League (NL). He was selected in the second round, 34th overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2013 NHL Entry Draft. de la Rose has also previously played for the Detroit Red Wings and St. Louis Blues.
